title: Accessibility of right adjoints between presentable infinity categories
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D$ be presentable infinity categories and let $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be a coherent functor admitting a left adjoint. Then there is an infinite regular cardinal $\rho\in\mathcal U$ such that $R$ preserves all small $\rho$-filtered colimits; that is, $R$ is accessible. The universes and coherent infinity-category notions used here are those of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category] and [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones].

source.place: HTT Proposition 5.4.7.7 (a functor between accessible infinity categories admitting a left adjoint is accessible), used for the 'only if' direction of Corollary 5.5.2.9(2); Definition 5.5.3.1(3) and Proposition 5.5.3.3
